sources.title: A quantitative description of membrane current and its application to conduction and excitation in nerve
sources.took: The squid giant axon: INa = gNa m³h (V − ENa), IK = gK n⁴ (V − EK), the rate functions (Eqs. 12, 13, 20, 21, 23, 24, p. 519) and the three forms they take, the constants of Table 3 (p. 520), and the Q10 of 3 from 6.3 °C. All checked against the port in src/core/hh.test.ts. For the 1952 screen: the sign of V and of current (p. 505), Table 1 (p. 510) and the measured points of Fig. 3 (p. 508, traced), the shocks of Fig. 12 (p. 525), Table 4 (p. 527), and Fig. 19 (p. 532).

sources.title: hh.mod: the Hodgkin–Huxley mechanism built into the NEURON simulator
sources.took: The 1952 rate functions as NEURON writes them (vtrap at the removable singularities) and the temperature factor 3^((T − 6.3)/10); and the mechanism itself, run in NEURON 9.0.2 as the oracle the port is tested against (tools/neuron_oracle_hh.py).
